The photos show the bangs before I cut them. The center part looks more natural than many comparable wigs. The length and thickness are really great. Tangles in the back pretty easy tho. Put some dry shampoo on that boy to get rid of the shine that make it look fake & u good to go! I’ve gotten so many compliments on this wig !

reviews.t: It sheds and tangles a lot.
reviews.x: It's cute and all but it sheds a lot and gets very tangled. I'm very confused about the reviews saying it doesn't because I've never had a wig that sheds the way this one does before. All I had to do was barely run my fingers through it and I'd end up with lots of hair in my hands. I was hopping I'd be able to have this one for more than a weekend but all it did was stress me out. No thanks.

This wig is sooo upsetting because it could have been perfect if they just put more care into the construction. The hair is very pretty and looks real but you can see the tracks in the front of the wig and in the bangs. it’s so sad because it could be so nice but it’s just not. Very sad to have to return this one.

I love this hair so much! I don’t really write much reviews but this was totally worth it. It’s sooo beautiful and natural!! It doesn’t shed nor tangle a lot. The only thing is that there is a slight smell, but nothing too unmanageable. I seriously can’t wait to buy more of these.

it's really soft and thick. all i had to do for it was cut the bangs which is expected. the inside is really soft and it had claws which i usually don't expect from cheaper wigs. the color is so pretty too. love it. haven't used any heat on it, but great value for money.

This wig is exceptional quality for the price. Way better than any $20 wig from a costume store. Like everyone says the bangs need to be trimmed, but overall the wig is super soft, not shiny, and looks great.
I love this wig !!!!! I recently had to cut my hair super short because it was super damaged . Now I am super happy with this wig , it looks like human hair and I doesn’t feel cheap .

This product is way better than i imagined!  Looks pretty real for being fake - bought this for a female professor plum for Halloween.  It's a really pretty orange without being neon orange or darker like auburn.  The hairline at the top is filled, and usually when you get long wigs, you compromise fullness for length, but this one has both. reviews.t: Great buy! Going to buy in other colors ♥️
reviews.x: So I impulsively cut my hair, I had it long and red like this color and I was missing it a lot. So I bought this wig! I wasn’t expecting that much as I’ve bought wigs on Amazon before and they weren’t the best… BUT THIS ONE IS WONDERFUL! It’s beautiful and silky, and looks like real hair. There’s so much of it! It doesn’t shed a lot, and the wig cap part has clips on the inside which makes things so much easier! I love it a lot, and I’m going to order the black one so I can have one closer to my

I started buying wigs for online teaching and I was SO impressed. I needed to be Mrs. Frizzle and I wanted a good red wig and the suggested ones had bad reviews. I know it may seem like a scam price but I wore this for HOURS. The tiger $20 wig I bought from a different seller made my head itchy and the cap was not nearly as good as this one. Also, if this is for a costume it is the BEST Disney princess vibe.

I love bangs and texture, and this wig gives me both. My hair is 'naturally' orange, but is too thin to allow me to wear bangs or carry a voluminous style day to day. It is worth every penny. I was nervous about how affordable it was, but this is everything I was hoping for! I do agree that if you're not partial to longer bangs, you can easily give them a trim (as I did.) Other than that, this wig gets 5🌟

reviews.t: Amazing product for an amazing price!
reviews.x: Used it for a Nami from One Piece cosplay and it fit her character perfectly! Didn't even need any adjustments or work done on it, just put on and get in character. Will definitely recommend to all my friends and fellow cosplayers! Great shop, amazing customer support, shipped hastily and with great care! 5/5.

this is my first time purchasing a wig and i am so incredibly pleased with it!!! it’s thick, beautiful, and sooo worth the cost! i’m amazed that such a good wig could come at such an affordable price!! all my friends are obsessed with it too. Will be wearing this veryyyy often!

I am so impressed by how realistic this wig is, I have a decent assortment of wigs (all synthetic) and the quality of this one is amazing, I think most people would think it was real hair by the touch.
I love it!  The color is gorgeous and it's comfortable I worked two shifts in it and it didn't shift. I had to trim the bangs a little but that's it . Totally worth it! 😊
Absolutely love this wig. It's so soft and the clips on the cap really make this a secure fit! Will definitely buy more colors!!
Absolutely love this wig. This is my first time buying a wig and I’m surprised how cute it is! And how long and bright!
I loved how soft this hair is and how easy it was to comb through it. I definitely recommend buying it.

reviews.t: El color es el de la imagen
reviews.x: Me encantó esta peluca, la suavidad y el color hacen que sea de mis favoritas, la recomiendo.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the wig as great value and high quality for its low price.
Many customers describe the hair as soft, natural-looking, and manageable.
Several reviewers note the bangs are too long and need trimming.
Some customers report the wig sheds and tangles easily.
A few reviewers mention construction or packaging issues, such as visible tracks or a missing wig cap.
